From: Laura Mendez <laura.mendez@helioshealth.com>

Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO setup + invoicing cadence questions for Helios (preauth/po fields)

Hi David / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has a couple of questions before we can raise a formal PO:

- PO header: can you confirm the exact field set you require on the PO (vendor name, Redwood vendor ID, tax ID, billing address, contact, PO number format)? We need to map to our ERP.
- Net terms: our finance prefers Net60 for new vendors. Is Redwood able to offer Net60? If not, what alternatives (Net30 + early-pay discount) do you support?
- Invoice cadence: we run consolidated monthly payments; however our AP team can accept weekly micro-invoices if it simplifies split billing. What cadence works best operationally for Redwood?
- Holdback: do you ever apply holdback/retention on invoices during onboarding or first-quarter usage?

I've attached our standard PO template for reference (Helios_PO_Template.pdf). Also want to note that this is a mid-sized enterprise deal and our procurement sponsor is asking if a one-time onboarding credit can be applied to the first invoice in exchange for a 12-month committed minimum.

Can you confirm the pieces above and share a sample invoice layout so we can validate with AP?

Best,
Laura
Laura Mendez
Senior Procurement Manager, Helios Health

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Mendez <laura.mendez@helioshealth.com>

Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup + invoicing cadence questions for Helios (preauth/po fields)

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list, appreciate the template. Quick answers and next steps below.

PO fields (required):
- Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Redwood vendor ID: RDW-0073 (please include as PO header field)
- Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789 (include in vendor tax id field)
- Billing address: 450 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Primary billing contact: billing@redwoodinference.com (please put on the PO)
- PO number format: free-form allowed, but we ask you include a unique PO number and optionally an ERP vendor code.

Net terms:
- We can accommodate Net60 for enterprise accounts with approved credit. Our standard onboarding policy for Net60 customers includes a 5% holdback for the first 60 days (applied to the first one to three invoices depending on usage ramp).
- Alternatively, Net30 with a 2% early-pay discount is also an option if you prefer no holdback.

Invoice cadence:
- Operationally we prefer monthly consolidated invoices (one invoice per billing entity) — easiest for reconciliation. We can support weekly micro-invoices for high-volume integrations, but that may increase AP overhead on both sides.

Attachments: I'm attaching our Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf and a draft order form (OrderForm_V1.pdf) for Helios to review.

Next steps: Vanessa will propose an approach (Net60 + holdback vs Net30 + early-pay) and draft an order form with the Helios PO fields prefilled. Vivek, could you confirm the holdback process and any finance-side constraints?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

-David
David Kim
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0210

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup + invoicing cadence questions for Helios (preauth/po fields)

David / Vanessa — quick finance note so we have a clean position to share with Helios: 

1) Net60: acceptable for enterprise with signed order and credit review. We require the PO to include customer tax id and billing entity. We also need the bill-to address to match the tax entity on the PO for invoicing and VAT reasons (if applicable).

2) Holdback: standard practice on Net60 for new enterprise customers is a 5% holdback applied to the first two invoices (or until usage stabilizes and passes the agreed volume threshold). The holdback is returned on the first invoice after the 60-day observation period.

3) Alternate: Net30 + 2% early-pay discount; in that case we waive the holdback. This is often preferable for customers that want full invoice settlements.

4) Invoice samples: we'll provide a sample consolidated monthly invoice (PDF) and an example CSV export for AP/ERP mapping. We also need the PO to indicate whether split billing across BU codes is required.

I'll loop in accounting ops if Helios requests a custom cadence or a vendor code mapping.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup + invoicing cadence questions for Helios (preauth/po fields)

Laura — thanks for the template and context. Summarizing our options so procurement can pick the cleanest path forward: 

Option A (preferred for Helios large enterprise):
- Net60 (credit approved)
- 5% holdback applied to 1–2 invoices; returned after 60-day ramp or once agreed usage threshold is met
- Monthly consolidated invoice (default)

Option B (if you want zero holdback):
- Net30
- 2% early-pay discount (applies if payment received within 10 days of invoice)
- Monthly consolidated invoice

Operational notes: we will prefill your Helios PO fields on the order form so AP has the exact vendor/tax IDs. Attached is a prefilled OrderForm_V1.pdf (draft) and a DocuSign link for the order form: https://www.docusign.net/sign?d=RDW-Order-HL-2025-0817

Onboarding credit: Redwood can provide a one-time onboarding credit of $15,000 if Helios signs a 12-month committed minimum (this is a one-off concession tied to the deal id HL-2025-0817). If procurement wants that credit displayed on the first invoice, please include a PO line referencing the credit so it maps cleanly in your ERP.

Next steps I suggest: 1) Tell us which option (A or B) you prefer; 2) Share the PO number and any BU mapping; 3) We'll return an updated order form for signature.

Call to action: if you want to lock Net60 + onboarding credit, reply with approval and I'll send an updated order form for signature today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Vanessa / David — thanks for the options and fast turnaround. Procurement has reviewed and we are prepared to proceed with Option A (Net60 with 5% holdback). A few final asks before we raise the formal PO: 

1) Can you send a sample invoice PDF and a CSV layout for ERP import so our AP can test mapping?
2) Please confirm the exact PO header we should include (we will use your RDW-0073 vendor ID). We need the line-by-line field names to map to our ERP.
3) We will include a single PO referencing the onboarding credit per your instructions. Please add a one-line annotation in the order form to show the $15,000 credit on the first invoice.

Attached is the draft Helios_PO_20250817.pdf with our preferred vendor code mapping and the Helios GL distribution. Please review and confirm any mismatches.

Once you confirm (1)-(3) we'll open the PO and send the PO number. We expect to route the order through our accounts payable workflow next week.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Mendez
Senior Procurement Manager, Helios Health
